name: Aquarium
summary: Your agents become fish. On the desktop every agent swims while ForkMesh is in the background, shaped by its status, changed files and conflicts; on the iPhone running agents swim over the app. They play with buttons and the Genie spider.

screenshots.alt: The ForkMesh window under water, with agent fish reading a heading, booping a button and swimming rings around the Genie spider

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

permissions.label: Add an Aquarium button to the desktop rail
Cover the window with the aquarium while ForkMesh is in the background, drawn over a picture of the window
See your agents, their status, changed files and merge conflicts, to give each one a fish
On the iPhone, swim over the app in a layer that lets every touch through and keeps off buttons and logos
